g.text: The repair run does not cover the earlier throughput frontier
Same normalization anchor within each model; different layouts and concurrency coverage
Dashed and solid lines use different configuration grids and code versions; this is a coverage audit, not a paired speedup estimate.
Processor-rack budgets are assumed TDP sums. Published NVIDIA normalization is not used in this figure.
